wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: President and CEO [caption id="attachment_6801" align="alignleft" width="480"] Brett S. Paddock, P.E., President & CEO of Titanium Industries[/caption] Brett is the President and CEO of Titanium Industries, Inc. His diverse metals background consists of engineering consulting, fabrication, manufacturing, contracting, and sales. He has held positions of VP of Sales and Marketing, Director of Operations, and COO during his career with Titanium Industries. Prior to joining Titanium Industries, Inc. in 2001, he was Director of Operations for one of the nation’s largest structural steel fabricator/erectors and Principal of an Eastern US engineering design and consulting firm. He holds a bachelor’s of science degree in engineering and a master’s of science degree in structural mechanics from Lehigh University and is a licensed professional engineer in multiple states. Brett is currently serving as an Officer on the International Titanium Association’s Board of Directors. Brett enjoys many outdoor sports including skiing, swimming and running as well as leisure time boating across the East Coast of the U.S.
Brett S. Paddock, P.E. | President and CEO

Vice President & CFO Titanium Industries, Inc.  With over 20 years in accounting and finance, Robert joined T.I. in 2014 as VP of Finance and was promoted to CFO in 2015. Robert spent the first 10 years of his career in various increasingly more senior finance roles at a fortune 500 high-tech company involved in the automotive and cellular industries. Immediately prior to joining Titanium Industries, Robert worked with a private equity group where he was the CFO of a distribution company and a construction company. Robert holds a bachelor's degree in accounting from St. Josephs College and an MBA from Arizona State University. Robert enjoys volunteering for charitable organizations and most recently served at Clackamas Women’s Services as a Board of Director and Treasurer. His commitment and dedication to Clackamas Women’s Services exemplifies his passionate and caring attitude towards helping others within his community. Robert enjoys the outdoors were he spends a great amount of his time with his family as well as golfing and cycling.
Robert M. Barba | Vice President & CFO Titanium Industries, Inc.

Vice President of Sales and Marketing [caption id="attachment_6799" align="alignleft" width="480"] Greg Himstead, Vice President Sales and Marketing[/caption] With 26 years in the precision, high-performance metals industry Greg has worked on both sides of the mill and distribution fence in GM, Director, and VP roles in Sales, Marketing, Trading, and Executive management. Greg’s work experiences in a range of high-tech industries such as aerospace, power generation, electronics and telecommunications, consumer products, transportation, etc. have provided the opportunity to travel intensively across N. America and around the world spending significant time in China, Korea, Japan, Australia, The Philippines, Brazil, and India as well as a 3-year European based assignment managing sales, marketing and trading teams in France, Germany, Italy, Switzerland, the UK, India, and Hong Kong. Greg speaks both French and German at an intermediate level and enjoys physical fitness and recreational sports especially, running, cycling and tennis.

Titanium Rec Bars

Titanium rectangular bars, often referred to as blocks, are indispensable components across various industries due to their exceptional properties and versatility. These bars are meticulously crafted from titanium, a material renowned for its unparalleled combination of strength, lightweight nature, corrosion resistance, biocompatibility, and ability to withstand high temperatures. Here, we delve into the specifications, grades, and dimensions of titanium rectangular bars offered by Titanium Industries. Properties and Applications Titanium rectangular bars find applications in a myriad of challenging environments, owing to their exceptional attributes. They are extensively utilized in aerospace, medical, marine, chemical processing, and architectural sectors, where reliability and performance are paramount. The unique properties of titanium make it an ideal choice for critical components in aircraft structures, medical implants, corrosive chemical handling equipment, and architectural frameworks requiring both strength and durability. Specifications and Grades At Titanium Industries, we offer a comprehensive range of titanium rectangular bars designed to meet stringent industry standards and specifications. Our bars adhere to specifications such as AMS (Aerospace Material Specifications), ASTM (American Society for Testing and Materials), and MIL (Military Specifications), ensuring the highest quality and performance standards.

Titanium 6Al-4V Grade 5 Rectangle Bar

One of our flagship offerings is the Titanium 6Al-4V Grade 5 rectangle bar, manufactured to meet AMS 4928, AMS 4965, AMS 6930, AMS 6931, ASTM B348, and MIL-T-9047 specifications. This grade is highly coveted for its exceptional strength-to-weight ratio, making it a preferred choice in aerospace applications, including aircraft airframes, engine components, and landing gear assemblies.

Titanium 6Al-4V ELI Grade 23 Rectangle Bar

Additionally, we supply Titanium 6Al-4V ELI Grade 23 rectangle bar, compliant with AMS 2631, AMS 4930, ASTM F136, ASTM B348, and AMS 6932 specifications. This medical-grade titanium alloy is biocompatible and extensively used in the manufacture of surgical implants, prosthetic devices, and dental appliances, where biocompatibility and corrosion resistance are critical factors. Dimensional Range Our titanium rectangular bars are available in a wide range of dimensions to cater to diverse application requirements. From small-sized bars measuring .250 inches (6.35mm) x .500 inches (12.7mm) to larger bars measuring 2.250 inches (57.15mm) x 4.250 inches (107.95mm), we offer versatility in size to accommodate various project needs. Conclusion In conclusion, Titanium Industries is your trusted partner for high-quality titanium rectangular bars. With a focus on meeting industry standards, offering a diverse range of grades, and providing flexibility in dimensions, we strive to exceed customer expectations and deliver solutions tailored to specific application requirements. Whether it's aerospace, medical, marine, or any other industry, our titanium rectangular bars stand as a testament to quality, reliability, and performance. Contact us today to explore our offerings and embark on your next project with confidence.
